title: Our Wedding
welcome: Join us for a weekend of celebration beneath the plane trees of a Provençal château. We can't wait to share our big day with you.
caption_2018: A New Year's kiss that accidentally turned into a lifetime. One year of long-distance later, the rest was history.
caption_2019: Wandering near and far, diving deeper into who we were, and accidentally discovering we'd found our person all along.
caption_2020: Tested by quarantine, proven unbreakable, and crazy enough to buy a house in the middle of it all.
caption_2021: Despite endless lockdowns, we still made sure to live. Chasing down live beats, exploring new places, and building a home we loved coming back to.
caption_2022: First the house, then the cat, and then Oli. Our very heart, now living out in the world. Our quiet life took on a whole new dimension, it was never the same again, and we never knew love could multiply like that.
caption_2023: Less sleep, way more love, and learning on the fly. A year full of milestones and discovering that the best team we've ever made was this little family of three.
caption_2024: Professional wedding guests in full force. A year spent traveling, celebrating everyone else's big days, and knowing ours was around the corner.
caption_2025: Plot twist! A sweet detour on the way to the altar: 2025 gave us a growing bump and the news to prove our world could grow even bigger.
caption_2026: He finally asked the question, after a very thorough almost ten-year trial run, and Kimi arrived to complete the puzzle. Our little family is officially whole, and we can't wait to celebrate the love that brought us here and the infinity ahead with each of you.
invited_body: We can't wait to celebrate ten years together and the lifetime ahead with our favorite people in a place that is close to our hearts. The celebrations will span several days, leading up to the big day on July 31st. Expect incredible views, good food, flowing wine, great beats, and unforgettable company. Please RSVP by October 30th. Full schedule and details coming soon to this page.
